verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਿੰਮਿਆ ਆਸਾਵੰਤੀ ਉਦਰੁ ਮਝਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: maat pitaa mil ni(n)miaa aasaava(n)tee udhar majhaare|

en.bdb: Meeting and mating of mother and father makes the mother pregnant who becoming hopeful keeps the child in her womb.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਸ ਕਸ ਖਾਇ ਨਿਲਜ ਹੋਇ ਛਹੁ ਛਹੁ ਧਰਣਿ ਧਰੈ ਪਗ ਧਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: ras kas khai nilaj hoi chhahu chhahu dharan dharai pag dhaare|

en.bdb: She enjoys edibles and unedibles without any inhibition and moves carefully with measured steps on the earth.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੇਟ ਵਿਚਿ ਦਸ ਮਾਹ ਰਖਿ ਪੀੜਾ ਖਾਇ ਜਣੈ ਪੁਤੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: peT vich dhas maeh rakh peeRaa khai janai put piaare|

en.bdb: She gives birth to her dear son after bearing the pain of carrying him in her womb for ten months.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਣ ਕੈ ਪਾਲੈ ਕਸਟ ਕਰਿ ਖਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਜਮ ਸਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: jan kai paalai kasaT kar khaan paan vich sa(n)jam saare|

en.bdb: Having delivered, the mother nourishes the child and herself remains moderate in eating and drinking.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁੜ੍ਹਤੀ ਦੇਇ ਪਿਆਲਿ ਦੁਧੁ ਘੁਟੀ ਵਟੀ ਦੇਇ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: guRhatee dhei piaal dhudh ghuTee vaTee dhei nihaare|

en.bdb: Having ministered the customary first food, and milk, she stares at him with deep love.

verses.gurmukhi: ਛਾਦਨੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਪੋਖਿਆ ਝੰਡਨ ਮੰਗਨ ਪੜ੍ਹਨ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: chhaadhan bhojan pokhiaa jha(n)ddan ma(n)gan paRhan chitaare|

en.bdb: She thinks about his food, clothes, tonsure, betrothal, education etc.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਂਧੇ ਪਾਸਿ ਬਹਾਲਿਆ ਖਟਿ ਲੁਟਾਇ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਚਿਆਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: paa(n)dhe paas bahaaliaa khaT luTai hoi suchiaare|

en.bdb: Throwing handful of coins over his head and giving him a proper bath she sends him to the pundit for education.
This way she clears the debt (of her motherhood).
